name: YOOZOO Interactive Co., Ltd.
summary: YOOZOO Interactive Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, operation, and distribution of mobile and PC games in China and internationally. It operates through Mobile Games, PC Games, and Other segments. The company also offers online games. In addition, it engages in investment management; software development and design; enterprise management; enterprise management consulting; Internet and related services; scientific research and technical services; international trade and information technology; retail; and technology promotion and application services.
